stack.db: Drizzle ORM on Cloudflare D1 (binding DB); migrations via drizzle-kit (pnpm run db:generate); never hand-write SQL
stack.models: Per-stage registry via Cloudflare AI Gateway — Gemini 3 Pro Image (GEMINI_API_KEY); Fal (FAL_API_KEY): bria/fibo-edit, nano-banana-pro/edit, flux-pro/kontext, flux-2-pro/edit, fast-sdxl; Replicate (REPLICATE_API_TOKEN): black-forest-labs/flux-depth-pro, black-forest-labs/flux-kontext-max (async). Never raw fal.run or api.replicate.com.

hard_constraints: NO sharp/libvips on Workers — crop via Cloudflare Images transforms.
NO interactive db.transaction() on D1 — use db.batch([...]) for atomic multi-row writes.

Per-stage provider selection behind a StageProvider interface, ALL routed through Cloudflare AI Gateway. Gemini 3 Pro default for structure-critical stages (base, rough-in); Fal (native gateway provider) Seedream v4 edit / FLUX first-class for try-on/finish. FAL_API_KEY is wired.
Always EDIT the real blank-canvas image; pin image_config (aspect_ratio + image_size); never generate from scratch.
Pass Cloudflare Images delivery URLs to models, not large base64 strings.
Use global crypto.randomUUID(); reuse AI Gateway via existing inline-editor.ts pattern.
ALL Fal calls route through Cloudflare AI Gateway /fal (or x-fal-target-url) — never raw https://fal.run.
Treat Fal model slugs + pricing as to-be-verified against the live catalog (via the gateway) before wiring; keep slugs in one registry config module.

Cloudflare Images upload URL is https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{id}/images/v1 (Bearer token via getCloudflareImagesToken, account via getCloudflareAccountId); pass image/mask URLs, not base64.
Real-time progress: a Worker WebSocket MUST be terminated by a Durable Object — otherwise reuse the existing realtime channel or use SSE/polling; never a bare Worker WS.
Layer-0 prep (if built) = object-removal/inpainting that keeps the room shell. Do NOT use BiRefNet background removal (it keeps the foreground, drops the background).

Black Forest Labs flux-depth-pro and flux-kontext-max are NOT on Fal — route via Replicate through the gateway /replicate path (REPLICATE_API_TOKEN). Replicate is ASYNC: create prediction, poll urls.get or send 'Prefer: wait', then read output[0].
